ModMetaData.name: Desert Vehicle Reskin — Alpha Vehicles Neolithic
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Redraws the draught animals in Alpha Vehicles - Neolithic so its carts read as desert, not as medieval Europe.
Mostly texture overrides: every art file here sits at the exact path the donor's own ThingDef already asks for, so the vehicles, their stats and their research stay entirely the donor's, and Alpha Vehicles - Neolithic itself is never edited.
Two things go beyond art. A pair of XML PatchOperations retint and rename the dog sled as an eopie sled, and a small Harmony assembly widens what the draught vehicles will burn: the donor gives each cart exactly one fuel ThingDef (Hay for the chariots, ox cart and covered carriage; Kibble for the sled) because its fuel comp holds a single ThingDef and no ThingFilter, so there is no XML route to widen it. The patch makes any nutrition-giving vegetable-type food count — anything whose foodType carries Plant, VegetableOrFruit or Meal, excluding meat, animal products and drugs — plus, always, whatever the vehicle already declared, so nothing that fuels a cart today stops fuelling it. No defName is listed anywhere, so modded crops qualify on their own.
WHY THE ANIMAL AND NOT THE CART
The draught animals are drawn INTO the vehicle texture rather than spawned as pawns, so replacing them is a per-file art edit. The carts themselves are fine: an ox cart, a covered carriage and a chariot are as at home on a desert world as anywhere. Only what pulls them is off-theme.
Seven of the donor's vehicles are untouched because they have no animal to replace — the wheelbarrow, hwacha, rickshaw and palanquin are human-powered, the balloon is Air, and the row boat and outrigger canoe are Sea.
CONTENTS
Things/Vehicles/Land/Tier0/DogSled/AV_DogSled_{north,south,east} A team of two eopies in place of four dogs. The eopie is Tatooine's canonical beast of burden; four dogs at a sled's scale read as a polar expedition. Two animals rather than four because the eopie is the larger beast — the harness traces are re-routed as a two-animal Y. Each facing is drawn, not mirrored: south is a head-on pair abreast, north is a rear view with no snout and the rigging hanging down, east is a side profile with the pair stacked vertically and the rigging to the left.
Things/Vehicles/Land/Tier0/DogSled/AV_DogSled_{north,south,east}m The paired colour masks, edited in step with the art. Vehicle Framework reads these for its colour and pattern system, so a mask left stale makes the new animal refuse to tint. Note the donor's suffix convention: the "m" is appended to the facing (AV_DogSled_southm), not separated (AV_DogSled_south_m).
LOAD ORDER MATTERS HERE
Alpha Vehicles - Neolithic ships its vehicle art as loose PNGs, not as an AssetBundle. Between two loose files at the same path RimWorld resolves by load order, so this mod must load AFTER the donor or the donor's own art wins and nothing here is visible. That is the opposite of an AssetBundle override, where a loose file wins regardless of order.
